description: PAID, $0.01-$4.99 USDC by size (shown in list_datasets). Every row of a dataset in one download, e.g. dataset_id=live_crypto_top500_markets (~155 coins, Chainlink on-chain prices). Formats: json, jsonl, csv or markdown. Live feeds refresh about every 30 min. An unpaid call returns the exact x402 price. Returns every row of the dataset in the requested format (json, jsonl, csv, or markdown).

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

dataset_id.description: Dataset id from list_datasets. Format: the dataset_id string. Example: live_crypto_top500_markets. Required. The USDC price is the one list_datasets shows for that id.

format.description: File format of the download. Format: one of the allowed values. Example: csv. Default: json. Allowed values: json, jsonl, csv, markdown.

name: buy_dataset
title: Buy a dataset (paid)
